_comment: M8.2: the movies on FFmpeg (docs/FFMPEG_MIGRATION_PLAN.md sections 2.3 and 3). Entry hooks on the eleven call stubs through which the game's movie class calls Bink (tools/movie_inventory.py; the stubs lie outside Bink's range, which M8.4 excludes): port/native/movie/bink_native.cpp answers each call natively when DOTHEROES_NATIVE_MOVIE turns the guard on; a call it declines (the guard 0, a handle that is not the native player's, a file FFmpeg cannot open) runs the stub, and Bink, as before. Each answer stores the caller's TOC where the stub would (sp + 0x28). Addresses only.

entry_hooks.note: Bink's sound module given, before an open (-> 0x00A56B20)
the sets' planes, before a decode (-> 0x00A56FE8)
the next frame into the next set (-> 0x00A5B158)
is the frame after due too? (-> 0x00A5D960)
the sound's end, after a close (-> 0x00A560E8)
